client_updates.highlight: Lighthouse: simplifying networking stack; prototyping EIP-8411 and attestation bundling
Prysm: partial columns merged and enabled by default for Fulu and Gloas; peer scoring/connectivity revamp soaking on mainnet and Hoodi nodes; dashboard demo planned for next call
Lodestar: QUIC 1.3 in progress; partial columns not enabled until after Gloas mainnet
Geth (Csaba): published post on blob pool protections; hardening of sparse blob pools this cycle

gloas_sepolia_bandwidth_profile.highlight: Post-Glamsterdam Sepolia bandwidth profile: execution payloads propagate immediately at slot start, not after attestation threshold
Lodestar (no partial columns): data column sidecar bandwidth ~10x higher than Prysm (e.g., ~1 MB vs ~120 KB per block)
Lodestar receiving up to 77 copies of execution payload per message (~150 KB × 61+); likely IDONTWANT bug fixed in recent release — version under investigation

service_discovery.highlight: Felix (Geth): topic-based service discovery now in discv5 spec, replacing old unimplemented messages; allows targeted peer search without ENR encoding
Spec considered final; Geth implementation (with Datahop) in progress but not merged; incremental deployment supported — not all nodes need to upgrade simultaneously
Per-node index table is bounded (constant storage overhead); scales with network size; post-quantum ENR growth motivates moving away from full-network crawl assumption

dc_simulations_decoupled_consensus.highlight: Sukun: Shadow sims (100 nodes, 20% supernodes) testing decoupled consensus with 8-slot rounds; 2,500 attesters/subnet vs. ~500 today; 500-node Cloud Run sim scheduled for tomorrow

Three strategies under simulation: (1) all FFG votes at slot start, (2) staggered per-second publishing, (3) three committees across slot; goldfish vote latency improves significantly in strategies 2 and 3
Key problem: no cross-topic stream prioritization between goldfish and FFG meshes; QUIC stream priorities only work per-connection
Plan: integrate GossipSub IHAVE/IHAVEv1 tracer; also attempt to make X-ray work with Shadow simulations

eip_proposals_hegota.highlight: EIP-8411 (segmented execution payload broadcast): CFI for Hegota; splits payload into 64 chunks; reduces propagation latency ~3×; includes consensus change adding chunk root to bid
Lodestar concern: insufficient mainnet data showing propagation problems; risk of scope creep delaying Hegota past June; prefer deferral to I-star if not clearly needed

Counter-arguments: testnets lack realistic builder/home-node/bandwidth conditions; machinery needed regardless for PQ signatures and LeanVM proofs; segmentation is a prerequisite unlock (consensus bid change) for future networking work
Lighthouse committed to implement EIP-8411 regardless of Hegota inclusion, with backward compatibility; Prysm expressed interest (thumbs up from Vlad/Gattaca)

action_items.action: Lodestar: verify IDONTWANT fix is present in Sepolia-targeted release; investigate 60-77 duplicate execution payload copies observed
Add X-ray support to Shadow simulator; raise PR
Raise EIP-8411 on upcoming ACDC call for broader client alignment

decisions.decision: Lighthouse will implement EIP-8411 regardless of Hegota fork inclusion, with network backward compatibility

targets.target: Decoupled consensus 500-node Cloud Run simulation — October 08, 2026 (tomorrow)
